question.body:
Let $f$ be the function defined by $f(x)= frac(3,2 x^(2)- 7 x + 5)$.

(a) Find the slope of the line tangent to the graph of $f$ at $x = 3$.

(b) Find the $x$-coordinate of each critical point of $f$ in the interval $1 < x < 2.5$. Classify each critical point as the location of a relative minimum, a relative maximum, or neither. Justify your answers.

(c) Using the identity that $frac(3,2 x^(2)- 7 x + 5)= frac(2,2 x - 5)- frac(1,x - 1)$, evaluate $integral_(5)^(oo) f(x) d x$ or show that the integral diverges.

(d) Determine whether the series $sum_(n = 5)^(oo) frac(3,2 n^(2)- 7 n + 5)$ converges or diverges. State the conditions of the test used for determining convergence or divergence.
